files.main.gd:
extends Control
## Mini check: pick any 2 cards with the same rank to score.
const Card = preload("card.gd")

var hand: Array = []
var picked: Array = []
var score_lbl: Label

func _ready() -> void:
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = Color("#1f6f4a")
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(bg)
	score_lbl = G.label("0", 40)
	score_lbl.position = Vector2(40, 30)
	add_child(score_lbl)
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.position = Vector2(200, 420)
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	add_child(row)
	for i in 6:
		var c = Card.new()
		c.setup([3, 3, 7, 9, 9, 12][i], i % 4)
		c.clicked.connect(_on_card)
		row.add_child(c)
		hand.append(c)

func _on_card(c) -> void:
	c.selected = not c.selected
	c.queue_redraw()
	G.sfx("pop")
	if c.selected:
		picked.append(c)
	else:
		picked.erase(c)
	if picked.size() == 2:
		if picked[0].rank == picked[1].rank:
			G.add_score(50)
			score_lbl.text = str(G.score)
			G.float_text(c.get_global_rect().get_center(), "+50", G.color(2))
			if G.score >= 100:
				G.win(G.score, 3)
		for p in picked:
			p.selected = false
			p.queue_redraw()
		picked.clear()

func auto_test() -> void:
	await G.wait(0.3)
	G.check(hand.size() == 6, "dealt 6 cards")
	print("rect=", hand[0].get_global_rect(), " hovered-before")
	G.click(hand[0])
	await G.wait(0.1)
	print("sel=", hand[0].selected, " hovered=", get_viewport().gui_get_hovered_control(), " paused=", get_tree().paused)
	G.click(hand[1])
	await G.wait(0.1)
	G.check(G.score == 50, "pair scores 50")
	G.click(hand[3])
	await G.wait(0.1)
	G.click(hand[4])
	await G.wait(0.3)
	G.check(G.score == 100, "second pair reaches 100")
